brief.topic: AgentRQ exact implementation paths for queue claim and MCP continuation

criteria.question: Read the pinned repository.go, model.go and repository tests. Report the exact GetNextTask/dequeue query, task fields, indexes, status transition and concurrency/claim transaction behavior.
Read the pinned server.go, app.go, mcp.go and MCP tests. Report the exact getTask, updateTaskStatus, reply, session mapping, channel notification and workspace scope behavior.
Read the pinned event.go, task.go and event/task tests. Report event/workflow task creation, result/message publication, status transitions and any reviewer continuation semantics.
Read the pinned client_identity.go, model.go, telemetry.go and stats.go paths. Report persisted identity, telemetry and whether they constitute AgentInstance claim provenance.
Read the pinned index.ts, sessions.ts, client.ts, tools.ts and plugin tests. Report task push delivery, session lifecycle, reconnect, catch-up, duplicate suppression and workspace profile isolation.
